attributes.name: Druva - Unusually Long Backup Activity Window
attributes.description: Detects resources with backup-related activity spanning an unusually long period during the detection window.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects resources with backup-related activity spanning an unusually long period during the detection window.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(message), TO_STRING(druva.event_type), ""))
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(TO_STRING(druva.resource.name), TO_STRING(druva.resource.name))
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL AND event_text LIKE "*backup*"
| STATS
    first_event = MIN(event_time),
    last_event = MAX(event_time),
    event_count = COUNT(*)
  BY resource
| EVAL duration_minutes = DATE_DIFF("minutes", first_event, last_event)
| WHERE event_count >= 5 AND duration_minutes >= 360
